import json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.gauntlet_draft import draft_gauntlet
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root=Path(raw)
    (root/'pyproject.toml').write_text('[project]\nname="demo"\nversion="1"\n[project.scripts]\ndemo="demo:main"\n', encoding='utf-8')
    (root/'api.py').write_text('from fastapi import FastAPI\napp=FastAPI()\n@app.get("/health")\ndef health(): return {}\n', encoding='utf-8')
    result=draft_gauntlet(root, 'smoke-draft')
    assert result['draft']['marker']=='GAUNTLET_DRAFT_CREATED'
    assert result['draft']['facts']['runnable_manifest_count']==0
    source=json.loads(Path(result['source_path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert source['promises'][0]['status']=='DRAFT'
    assert source['unresolved_http_routes'][0]['route']=='/health'
print('EVIDENCE_SUPPLY_DRAFT_INERT')
